lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Organized into roughly ten visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits. Blobs within the columns exhibit a regular vertical spacing of approximately 1.5 to 2 blob-diameters in the mid-flank region, with a slight staggered horizontal offset between adjacent columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of blobs, creating a coordinate-like intersection at each primary spot location to form a structured rectilinear grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. The ridges show a clear luminance gradient, with the highest pixel intensity on the superior edge and a sharp shadow-based drop-off on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular, high-luminance patch is visible on the dorsal-lateral surface above the fourth and fifth gill slits, indicating a localized depigmentation or healed abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish silhouettes (Remora sp.) positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin; pectoral fin displays a high density of smaller, non-linear high-luminance spots.
